notes.title: Patch Note 1.8
notes.content:
Hi, Researchers!

We've released version 1.8, bringing several fixes and improvements:


 Fixed numerous bugs, including soft locks.
 Simplified the parkour location for a smoother experience.
 Added 2 new locations to explore.
 Optimized several levels for better performance.


Note: The first anomaly level still has performance issues. We're actively working on a solution.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Patch Note 1.56: Bug fixes and Interior Overwork.
notes.content:
1) Fixed a very common bug with elevator on the first level.
2) Added some new interior things to all living rooms.
3) Fully reworked Kitchen. Now it looks much more realistic.

notes.title: Patchnote 1.4: Fix bugs
notes.content: Fixed some bugs caused to anomalies.

notes.title: Patchnote 1.2: Improvements and Rebalancing
notes.content:
Fixed minor bugs.
Added new anomaly.
Added some interactivity on the 4 Level.

notes.title: Patchnote 1.1: Black Screen issue
notes.content: Changed some compiler settings and switched to the Direct X11, so this may helps to fix 'Black Screen' error on some devices.

notes.title: Patchnote 1: Fixes and Rebalancing
notes.content:
Rebalanced 'Back rooms' level to make it much more easier to complete this level.
Added some more interior props for the first location.
Added new secret achievement.
FIxed some minor and even critical bugs.
